classifications.rationale: The President presently sets binding basic-pay rates and locality payments through schedules incorporated into the order; those compensation consequences occur on the schedules’ specified effective dates, with later administration merely implementing them.
classifications.evidence: locality-based comparability payments shall be paid in accordance with Schedule 9 attached hereto and made a part hereof

classifications.rationale: This segment inseparably combines materially different postures: the OPM Director must perform later ministerial implementation and publication, the President presently sets administrative-law-judge pay and effective dates, and the President immediately supersedes a prior order.
classifications.evidence: The rates of basic pay for administrative law judges, as adjusted under 5 U.S.C. 5372(b)(4), are set forth on Schedule 10 attached hereto and made a part hereof.
